title: Head of the Pack
description: Warmaster Thane Bralt has read the reports: one great alpha, Greymaw, drives the fevered pack that harries the northern wolds, and the sickness dies down wherever he falls. The bounty board pays coin for the deed — the Warmaster wants it done as proof you can raise a party and lead it. Muster hunters and put Greymaw down.
location_hint: Northern wolds, north-east of the village (48, 40).

objectives.desc: Slay Greymaw the Alpha with a party
